texts.bp_handed: Wani mutum zai kira ka ko ya aiko maka da saƙo. Lambar ƙararka ita ce {case}.
texts.bp_kind_basic: Waya ta yau da kullum: USSD, saƙon tes da murya
texts.bp_link_sent: Mun aiko maka da hanyar haɗi ta SMS. Buɗe ta a wayar da ke da intanet.
texts.bp_locked: PIN marasa daidai sun yi yawa. An kulle asusunka, ba a goge komai ba. Dawo da shi a intanet ko ka tambayi mai shago.
texts.bp_low_rice: Kaya sun yi ƙasa: shinkafa kg 1
texts.bp_pin_again: Sake shigar da wannan PIN ɗin:
texts.bp_pin_help: Mai shago ko manaja ne ke sake saita PIN na ma'aikaci a na'urar. Na mai shago sai ta hanyar dawo da asusu a intanet kawai.
texts.bp_pin_mismatch: PIN ɗin ba su yi daidai ba.
texts.bp_read_more: Kira menu na LynkOmni sannan ka zaɓi Saƙonni don karanta ƙari.
texts.bp_recovery: Rubuta lambar dawo da asusunka ka adana ta lafiya: {code}
texts.bp_terms: Ka yarda da sharuɗɗan amfani da sanarwar sirri a lynkomni.com/legal?
texts.bp_too_young: Dole ne shekarunka su kai {age} ko fiye don samun asusu.
texts.bp_username: Zaɓi sunan mai amfani (haruffa, lambobi, . da _):
texts.bp_wrong_pin: PIN ba daidai ba ne. Saura gwaji {left} kafin a kulle.
texts.ch_no_command: Ba umarni ba ne. Aika 4 don taimako.
texts.ch_sandbox: Misali (gwaji): babu lamba ko kodin gaskiya har sai an sanya hannu kan ƙofar sadarwa a ƙasarka.
texts.ch_spoken: Ana karantawa da murya; danna lamba
texts.title: LynkPOS a wayar maɓalli
